VS Club Kanjak Gifts for Girls (Pack of 12) Complete Kanya Pujan Gift Set for Navratri | Includes Premium Stationery Kit (Pencil, Eraser, Sharpener) & Delicious Cndies| Jai Mata Di Navratri Return Gifts for Kids
✨ COMPLETE KANYA PUJAN GIFT SET FOR GIRLS: Save time this Navratri with our ready-to-use Kanjak gift packs. This set of 12 pre-packed return gifts for Kanya Pujan is the perfect solution for busy households during Ashtami and Navami pujan.
📚 PREMIUM STATIONERY RETURN GIFTS: Each mini pack is filled with essential school stationery items including a high-quality pencil, a sharpener, and a dust-free eraser. These are useful gifts for kids that parents appreciate and children love to use for school.
🍬 BULK BIRTHDAY & FESTIVE GOODY BAGS: Beyond Navratri, these serve as excellent birthday return gifts for kids or party favor bags. Each pack includes 2 delicious cndies and a vibrant butterfly hair clutcher, making it a delightful gift hamper for girls.
🙏 JAI MATA DI DEVOTIONAL THEME: Designed specifically for Hindu festival gifting, each pack features a beautiful Goddess Durga illustration and "Jai Mata Di" branding. It maintains the traditional and spiritual vibe of Navratri celebrations.
💰 BUDGET-FRIENDLY WHOLESALE PACK: Get the best value with this bulk gift set of 12. These affordable Kanjak items come beautifully packed in transparent sleeves, ensuring premium presentation without the high cost of individual gifting sets.
🌟 MULTI-PURPOSE FESTIVE GIFTING: While ideally designed for Kanjak / Kanya Pujan, these sets also serve as excellent return gifts for birthdays, school events, or any festive gathering for young girls and boys.
